editor_options:

---

This script reproduces the statistical analyses and figures for the manuscript.
Data and code are archived at https://doi.org/10.5281/zenodo.23679672.

**Input files** (place in the same folder as this .Rmd):

- `Chimp_data_full_worldclim_SEA_fin.csv`: hair δ13C/δ15N values (one row per sample) with site-level environmental variables and isotopic niche space (SEA)
- `behavioral_diversity.csv`: site-level behavioral diversity indices (behavior figures)
- `chimp_fossil_comp.csv`: enamel δ13C values for fossil hominoids (fossil comparison figure)

**Outputs** are written to `figures/` and `output/`, which are created if they do not exist.

```{r setup, include = FALSE}
knitr::opts_chunk$set(echo = TRUE, message = FALSE, warning = FALSE)
```

# Setup

## Packages

```{r packages}
library(arm)            # loads lme4 (lmer)
library(lme4)

library(AICcmodavg)     # aictab
library(performance)

library(interactions)
library(sjPlot)
library(coefplot)
library(ggplot2)
```

## Data, z-scores, and plotting settings

```{r data}
chimp_data <- read.csv("Chimp_data_full_worldclim_SEA_fin.csv")

fig_dir <- "figures"
out_dir <- "output"
dir.create(fig_dir, showWarnings = FALSE)
dir.create(out_dir, showWarnings = FALSE)

# Standardized (z-scored) predictors, stored as columns so models and
# interaction plots always use the rows of the data they are fit to
chimp_data <- chimp_data %>%
  mutate(
    zMAT       = as.numeric(scale(MAT)),
    zMAP       = as.numeric(scale(MAP)),
    zPTCmean   = as.numeric(scale(treeCoverMean)),
    zPTCm      = as.numeric(scale(treeCoverMax)),
    zPTCmedian = as.numeric(scale(treeCoverMedian)),
    zPTCmin    = as.numeric(scale(treeCoverMin)),
    zPTCmode   = as.numeric(scale(treeCoverMode)),
    zPE        = as.numeric(scale(percEvergreen)),
    zST        = as.numeric(scale(Temp_seasonality)),
    zEL        = as.numeric(scale(Elevation)),
    zNS        = as.numeric(scale(Niche_space)),
    zSP        = as.numeric(scale(Seasonality_Precipitation))
  )

# Taï is written with \u00EF to avoid Windows encoding issues
tai <- "Ta\u00EF"

chimp_groups <- c("Fongoli", "Solo", "Comoe", "Tenkere", "Bhukalai", "Issa",
                  "Nguye", "Kasakati", "Kalande", "Kasekela", "Mitumba", "Ishasha",
                  "Ngogo", "Ganta", tai, "Loango", "Kalinzu")

chimp_data$Group <- as.character(chimp_data$Group)
chimp_data$Group[chimp_data$Group == "Tai"] <- tai
chimp_data$Group <- factor(chimp_data$Group, levels = chimp_groups)

group_colors <- c(
  "Kalande"  = "#C6A700",
  "Kasekela" = "#A9BA9D",
  "Mitumba"  = "#87A96B",
  "Bhukalai" = "#FFB000",
  "Issa"     = "#FFD300",
  "Nguye"    = "#F9A825",
  "Kasakati" = "#E6AC00",
  "Solo"     = "#FFCA28",
  "Comoe"    = "#FBC02D",
  "Tenkere"  = "#B38F00",
  "Fongoli"  = "#9E8A00",
  "Ishasha"  = "#A2B627",
  "Ngogo"    = "#66A96B",
  "Ganta"    = "#006400",
  "Loango"   = "#1C5F40",
  "Kalinzu"  = "#6B8E23"
)
group_colors[tai] <- "#1F6E4A"

group_shapes <- c(
  "Kalande" = 15, "Kasekela" = 17, "Mitumba" = 16, "Bhukalai" = 0,
  "Issa" = 2, "Nguye" = 3, "Kasakati" = 7, "Solo" = 8, "Comoe" = 4,
  "Tenkere" = 5, "Fongoli" = 6, "Ishasha" = 18, "Ngogo" = 10,
  "Ganta" = 13, "Loango" = 14, "Kalinzu" = 1
)
group_shapes[tai] <- 12

# Helpers
# Significant simple regressions (p < cutoff) get a solid trend line;
# non-significant ones get a dashed line.
sig_linetype <- function(p, cutoff = 0.05) ifelse(p < cutoff, "solid", "dashed")

# Legend text for coefficient plots, taken from an aictab() table
aic_label <- function(aic_tab, model, label) {
  row <- aic_tab[aic_tab$Modnames == model, ]
  sprintf("%s: \u0394AIC = %.2f, \u03c9 = %.2f", label, row$Delta_AICc, row$AICcWt)
}
```

# Carbon (δ13C)

## Mixed models and model selection

```{r d13C-mixed-models}
m1  <- lmer(d13C ~ zMAP + (1 | Group), data = chimp_data, REML = FALSE)
m2  <- lmer(d13C ~ zMAT + (1 | Group), data = chimp_data, REML = FALSE)
m3  <- lmer(d13C ~ zEL + (1 | Group), data = chimp_data, REML = FALSE)
m4  <- lmer(d13C ~ zPTCm + (1 | Group), data = chimp_data, REML = FALSE)
m5  <- lmer(d13C ~ zSP + (1 | Group), data = chimp_data, REML = FALSE)
m6  <- lmer(d13C ~ zPTCm + zSP + (1 | Group), data = chimp_data, REML = FALSE)
m7  <- lmer(d13C ~ zPTCm + zMAP + (1 | Group), data = chimp_data, REML = FALSE)
m8  <- lmer(d13C ~ zPTCm * zSP + (1 | Group), data = chimp_data, REML = FALSE)
m9  <- lmer(d13C ~ zPTCm * zMAP + (1 | Group), data = chimp_data, REML = FALSE)
m10 <- lmer(d13C ~ zPTCm * zSP + zMAP + (1 | Group), data = chimp_data, REML = FALSE)
m11 <- lmer(d13C ~ zPTCm + zMAP + zSP * zMAP + (1 | Group), data = chimp_data, REML = FALSE)

# Single-predictor models
aictab(cand.set = list(m1 = m1, m2 = m2, m3 = m3, m4 = m4, m5 = m5))

# All candidate models
d13C_aic <- aictab(cand.set = list(m1 = m1, m2 = m2, m3 = m3, m4 = m4, m5 = m5, m6 = m6,
                                   m7 = m7, m8 = m8, m9 = m9, m10 = m10, m11 = m11))
d13C_aic

summary(m11)
plot_model(m11, type = "est")

interact_plot(
  m10,
  pred = zPTCm,
  modx = zMAP,
  mod2 = zSP,
  plot.points = TRUE,
  interval = TRUE,
  int.width = 0.95,
  mod2.labels = c("Low SP", "High SP")
)
```

## Coefficient and interaction plots

```{r d13C-coefplot}
combine_CIs <- function(m, model_name) {
  tidy(m, effects = "fixed", conf.int = TRUE, conf.level = 0.95) %>%
    filter(term %in% c("zPTCm", "zMAP", "zSP", "zMAP:zSP")) %>%
    rename(estimate = estimate, se = std.error, stat = statistic,
           CI_95_low = conf.low, CI_95_high = conf.high) %>%
    left_join(
      tidy(m, effects = "fixed", conf.int = TRUE, conf.level = 0.50) %>%
        filter(term %in% c("zPTCm", "zMAP", "zSP", "zMAP:zSP")) %>%
        dplyr::select(term, CI_50_low = conf.low, CI_50_high = conf.high),
      by = "term"
    ) %>%
    mutate(Model = model_name)
}

coef_df <- bind_rows(
  combine_CIs(m11, "m11"),
  combine_CIs(m4, "m4"),
  combine_CIs(m9, "m9")
)

coef_df$Model <- factor(coef_df$Model, levels = c("m9", "m4", "m11"))

coef_df <- coef_df %>%
  mutate(term = factor(term, levels = c("zMAP:zSP", "zSP", "zMAP", "zPTCm")))

dodge <- position_dodge(width = 0.6)
model_colors <- c("m9" = "#20B2AA", "m4" = "#5a9bd4", "m11" = "#2E8B57")

d13C_models_coef <- ggplot(coef_df, aes(x = term, y = estimate, color = Model)) +
  geom_errorbar(aes(ymin = CI_95_low, ymax = CI_95_high),
                width = 0, size = 0.5, alpha = 0.6, position = dodge) +
  geom_errorbar(aes(ymin = CI_50_low, ymax = CI_50_high),
                width = 0, size = 1.5, position = dodge) +
  geom_point(position = dodge, size = 2.2) +
  geom_hline(yintercept = 0, linetype = "dashed", color = "grey50") +
  coord_flip() +
  scale_color_manual(values = model_colors) +
  scale_x_discrete(labels = c(
    "zPTCm" = "Max Canopy Cover",
    "zMAP" = "Precipitation",
    "zSP" = "Precip. Seasonality",
    "zMAT" = "Temperature",
    "zMAP:zSP" = "Precipitation \n× Precip. Seasonality"
  )) +
  labs(x = NULL, y = "Estimate", title = expression(delta^{13}*C)) +
  scale_y_continuous(limits = c(-2.5, 2.5)) +
  theme_bw() +
  theme(
    panel.grid = element_blank(),
    legend.position = "none",
    axis.text = element_text(size = 12),
    axis.title = element_text(size = 14),
    plot.title = element_text(hjust = 0.05, size = 15)
  ) +
  annotate("point", x = 4.4, y = 0.3, color = "#2E8B57", size = 3) +
  annotate("text", x = 4.4, y = 0.4, label = aic_label(d13C_aic, "m11", "m11"), hjust = 0, size = 4) +
  annotate("point", x = 4.2, y = 0.3, color = "#5a9bd4", size = 3) +
  annotate("text", x = 4.2, y = 0.4, label = aic_label(d13C_aic, "m4", "m04"), hjust = 0, size = 4) +
  annotate("point", x = 4, y = 0.3, color = "#20B2AA", size = 3) +
  annotate("text", x = 4, y = 0.4, label = aic_label(d13C_aic, "m9", "m09"), hjust = 0, size = 4)

d13C_models_coef


ggsave(file.path(fig_dir, "d13C_models_coef.png"), plot = d13C_models_coef,
       width = 6.5, height = 4,
       dpi = 400)


d13c_int3 <- interact_plot(
  m11, pred = zMAP, modx = zSP,
  legend.main = "Precip. \nSeasonality",
  modx.labels = c("Low -1 SD", "Mean", "High +1 SD"),
  interval = TRUE,
  partial.residuals = TRUE,
  colors = c("#a1d99b", "#41ab5d", "#006d2c")
) +
  labs(
    title = "Precipitation × Precip. Seasonality",
    x = "Precipitation (z-score)",
    y = expression(paste(delta^{13}, "C (\u2030)")),
  ) +
  theme_bw() +
  theme(
    text = element_text(size = 12),
    axis.title = element_text(size = 12),
    axis.text = element_text(size = 12),
    legend.title = element_text(size = 12),
    legend.text = element_text(size = 10),
    plot.title = element_text(size = 12, hjust = 0.5)
  )
d13c_int3

ggsave(file.path(fig_dir, "d13c_int3.png"), plot = d13c_int3,
       width = 6, height = 5,
       dpi = 400)

```

## Single-predictor regressions

```{r d13C-single-predictor}

#MAP
d13c_MAP_lm <- lm(d13C ~ MAP, data = chimp_data)
summary(d13c_MAP_lm)

cMAP_r2 <- round(summary(d13c_MAP_lm)$adj.r.squared, 3)
cMAP_pval <- summary(d13c_MAP_lm)$coefficients["MAP", "Pr(>|t|)"]
cMAP_pval_label <- if (cMAP_pval < 0.001) {
  "p < 0.001"
} else {
  paste0("p = ", signif(cMAP_pval, 3))
}

d13c_MAP <- ggplot(data = chimp_data, mapping = aes(x = MAP, y = d13C)) +
  geom_point(
    aes(color = Group, shape = Group),
    size = 3, stroke = 1, alpha = 0.7,
    position = position_jitter(width = 0.2)
  ) +
  geom_smooth(method = "lm", se = TRUE, color = "black", linewidth = 0.8,
              linetype = sig_linetype(cMAP_pval)) +
  annotate("text",
           x = min(chimp_data$MAP, na.rm = TRUE),
           y = min(chimp_data$d13C, na.rm = TRUE),
           hjust = 0, vjust = 0, size = 4,
           label = paste0("Adj R² = ", cMAP_r2, "\n", cMAP_pval_label)) +
  coord_cartesian(ylim = c(min(chimp_data$d13C, na.rm = TRUE), NA)) +
  theme_bw() +
  theme(
    axis.line = element_line(size = 0.5, color = "black"),
    panel.background = element_blank(),
    text = element_text(size = 13),
    axis.text.x = element_text(color = "black", size = 13),
    axis.text.y = element_text(color = "black", size = 13)
  ) +
  scale_fill_manual(values = group_colors) +
  scale_color_manual(values = group_colors) +
  scale_shape_manual(values = group_shapes) +
  ylab(expression(paste(delta^{13}, "C (\u2030)"))) +
  xlab("Mean Annual Precipitation (mm)")
d13c_MAP

#MAT

  legend.position = "right",
  legend.title = element_text(size = 16),
  legend.text = element_text(size = 14),
  legend.key.size = unit(1, "cm"),
  legend.spacing.y = unit(0.2, "cm"),
  legend.margin = margin(0, 5, 0, 5)
```

# Nitrogen (δ15N)

## Mixed models and model selection

```{r d15N-mixed-models}
m16 <- lmer(d15N ~ zMAP + (1 | Group), data = chimp_data, REML = FALSE)
m17 <- lmer(d15N ~ zMAT + (1 | Group), data = chimp_data, REML = FALSE)
m18 <- lmer(d15N ~ zEL + (1 | Group), data = chimp_data, REML = FALSE)
m19 <- lmer(d15N ~ zPTCm + (1 | Group), data = chimp_data, REML = FALSE)
m20 <- lmer(d15N ~ zSP + (1 | Group), data = chimp_data, REML = FALSE)
m21 <- lmer(d15N ~ zSP + zMAP + I(zMAP^2) + (1 | Group), data = chimp_data, REML = FALSE)
m22 <- lmer(d15N ~ zSP + zMAP + (1 | Group), data = chimp_data, REML = FALSE)
m23 <- lmer(d15N ~ zSP * zMAP + (1 | Group), data = chimp_data, REML = FALSE)
m24 <- lmer(d15N ~ zSP * zMAP + I(zMAP^2) + (1 | Group), data = chimp_data, REML = FALSE)

# Single-predictor models
aictab(cand.set = list(m16 = m16, m17 = m17, m18 = m18, m19 = m19, m20 = m20))

# All candidate models
d15N_aic <- aictab(cand.set = list(m16 = m16, m17 = m17, m18 = m18, m19 = m19, m20 = m20,
                                   m21 = m21, m22 = m22, m23 = m23, m24 = m24))
d15N_aic

summary(m24)
plot_model(m24, type = "est")
```

## Coefficient and interaction plots

```{r d15N-coefplot}

combine_CIs <- function(m, model_name) {
  tidy(m, effects = "fixed", conf.int = TRUE, conf.level = 0.95) %>%
    filter(term != "(Intercept)") %>%
    rename(estimate = estimate, se = std.error, stat = statistic,
           CI_95_low = conf.low, CI_95_high = conf.high) %>%
    left_join(
      tidy(m, effects = "fixed", conf.int = TRUE, conf.level = 0.50) %>%
        filter(term != "(Intercept)") %>%
        dplyr::select(term, CI_50_low = conf.low, CI_50_high = conf.high),
      by = "term"
    ) %>%
    mutate(Model = model_name)
}

coef_df <- bind_rows(
  combine_CIs(m24, "m24"),
  combine_CIs(m23, "m23"),
  combine_CIs(m20, "m20")
)

coef_df <- coef_df %>%
  mutate(term = factor(term, levels = rev(unique(term))))

term_labels <- c(
  "zMAP" = "Precipitation",
  "I(zMAP^2)" = expression(Precipitation^2),
  "zSP" = "Precip. Seasonality",
  "zSP:zMAP" = "Precip. Seasonality \n x Precipitation"
)

model_colors <- c("m24" = "#8c3f5d", "m23" = "#6e4f2f", "m20" = "#e67e22")

dodge <- position_dodge(width = 0.6)

d15N_models_coef <- ggplot(coef_df, aes(x = term, y = estimate, color = Model)) +
  geom_errorbar(aes(ymin = CI_95_low, ymax = CI_95_high),
                width = 0, size = 0.5, alpha = 0.6, position = dodge) +
  geom_errorbar(aes(ymin = CI_50_low, ymax = CI_50_high),
                width = 0, size = 1.5, position = dodge) +
  geom_point(position = dodge, size = 2.2) +
  geom_hline(yintercept = 0, linetype = "dashed", color = "grey50") +
  coord_flip() +
  scale_color_manual(values = model_colors) +
  scale_x_discrete(labels = term_labels) +
  scale_y_continuous(limits = c(-3, 3)) +
  labs(x = NULL, y = "Estimate", title = expression(delta^{15}*N)) +
  theme_bw() +
  theme(
    panel.grid = element_blank(),
    legend.position = "none",
    axis.text = element_text(size = 12),
    axis.title = element_text(size = 14),
    plot.title = element_text(hjust = 0.05, size = 15)
  ) +
  annotate("point", x = 4.4, y = 0.4, color = "#8c3f5d", size = 3) +
  annotate("text", x = 4.4, y = 0.5, label = aic_label(d15N_aic, "m24", "m24"), hjust = 0, size = 4) +
  annotate("point", x = 4.2, y = 0.4, color = "#6e4f2f", size = 3) +
  annotate("text", x = 4.2, y = 0.5, label = aic_label(d15N_aic, "m23", "m23"), hjust = 0, size = 4) +
  annotate("point", x = 4, y = 0.4, color = "#e67e22", size = 3) +
  annotate("text", x = 4, y = 0.5, label = aic_label(d15N_aic, "m20", "m20"), hjust = 0, size = 4)

d15N_models_coef

ggsave(file.path(fig_dir, "d15N_models_coef.png"), plot = d15N_models_coef,
       width = 6.5, height = 4,
       dpi = 400)

# m25 is m24 with the squared term as a column, which interact_plot() requires
chimp_data$zMAP_sq <- chimp_data$zMAP^2
m25 <- lmer(d15N ~ zSP * zMAP + zMAP_sq + (1 | Group), data = chimp_data, REML = FALSE)

d15n_int1 <- interact_plot(
  m25, pred = zSP, modx = zMAP,
  legend.main = "Precipitation",
  modx.labels = c("Low -1 SD", "Mean", "High +1 SD"),
  interval = TRUE,
  partial.residuals = TRUE,
  colors = c("#c97e97", "#8c3f5d", "#5d263b")
) +
  labs(
    title = "Precip. Seasonality x Precipitation",
    x = "Precip. Seasonality (Z-score)",
    y = expression(paste(delta^{15}, "N (\u2030)")),
  ) +
  theme_bw() +
  theme(
    text = element_text(size = 12),
    axis.title = element_text(size = 12),
    axis.text = element_text(size = 12),
    legend.title = element_text(size = 12),
    legend.text = element_text(size = 10),
    plot.title = element_text(size = 12, hjust = 0.5)
  )
d15n_int1

ggsave(file.path(fig_dir, "d15n_int1.png"), plot = d15n_int1,
       width = 6, height = 5,
       dpi = 400)
```

```{r niche-space-single-predictor}
#MAP

MAP_model_gam <- gam(Niche_space ~ s(MAP, bs = "cs", k = 3), data = chimp_data)

map_pval <- map_summary$s.table[1, "p-value"]

  "p < 0.001"
} else {
  paste0("p = ", signif(map_pval, 3))
}

map_seq <- seq(min(chimp_data$MAP, na.rm = TRUE),
               max(chimp_data$MAP, na.rm = TRUE),
               length.out = 100)

pred_map <- predict(MAP_model_gam,
                    newdata = data.frame(MAP = map_seq),
                    se.fit = TRUE)

gg_NS_MAP <- ggplot(chimp_data, aes(x = MAP, y = Niche_space, color = Group, shape = Group)) +
  geom_point(size = 3) +
  geom_line(data = data.frame(MAP = map_seq, Niche_space = pred_map$fit),
            aes(x = MAP, y = Niche_space), inherit.aes = FALSE,
            color = "black", linewidth = 0.8) +
  geom_ribbon(data = data.frame(MAP = map_seq,
                                ymin = pred_map$fit - 2 * pred_map$se.fit,
                                ymax = pred_map$fit + 2 * pred_map$se.fit),
              aes(x = MAP, ymin = ymin, ymax = ymax),
              inherit.aes = FALSE, fill = "black", alpha = 0.2) +
  annotate("text",
         x = max(map_seq),
         y = max(chimp_data$Niche_space, na.rm = TRUE),
         hjust = 1, vjust = 1, size = 3,
         label = paste0("Adj R² = ", map_r2,
                        "\nEDF = ", map_edf,
                        "\n", map_pval_label))+
  scale_color_manual(values = group_colors) +
  scale_shape_manual(values = group_shapes) +
  labs(title = "", x = "Mean Annual Precipitation (mm)", y = "Isotopic Niche Space") +
  theme_bw()+
  theme(axis.title = element_text(size = 10),

            aes(x = Elevation, y = Niche_space), inherit.aes = FALSE,
            color = "black", linewidth = 0.8, linetype = sig_linetype(el_pval)) +
  geom_ribbon(data = data.frame(Elevation = el_seq,
                                ymin = pred_el$fit - 2 * pred_el$se.fit,
                                ymax = pred_el$fit + 2 * pred_el$se.fit),
              aes(x = Elevation, ymin = ymin, ymax = ymax),
              inherit.aes = FALSE, fill = "black", alpha = 0.2) +
  annotate("text",
           x = max(el_seq),
           y = max(chimp_data$Niche_space, na.rm = TRUE),
           hjust = 1, vjust = 1, size = 3,
           label = paste0("Adj R² = ", el_r2,
                          "\n", el_pval_label)) +
  scale_color_manual(values = group_colors) +
  scale_shape_manual(values = group_shapes) +
  labs(title = "", x = "Elevation (m)", y = "Isotopic Niche Space") +
  theme_bw() +
  theme(axis.title = element_text(size = 10),
        axis.text = element_text(size = 9))

gg_NS_EL
```

## Projected niche space and simulated isotope values

```{r future-simulation}

# SP_model_gam: Niche_space ~ s(Seasonality_Precipitation), fit in the niche space section
spline_future <- predict(SP_model_gam, newdata = data.frame(
  Seasonality_Precipitation = chimp_data$SSP245AVG_2041_precip
), type = "terms")[, "s(Seasonality_Precipitation)"]

spline_now <- predict(SP_model_gam, newdata = data.frame(
  Seasonality_Precipitation = chimp_data$Seasonality_Precipitation
), type = "terms")[, "s(Seasonality_Precipitation)"]

spline_delta <- spline_future - spline_now

chimp_data$Projected_Niche_2041 <- chimp_data$Niche_space + spline_delta

chimp_data$Delta_Niche_Space <- spline_delta

export_data <- chimp_data[, c("Group", "Site", "Niche_space",
                              "Seasonality_Precipitation", "SSP245AVG_2041_precip",
                              "Projected_Niche_2041", "Delta_Niche_Space")]

write.csv(export_data, file.path(out_dir, "projected_niche_space_2041_GAM.csv"), row.names = FALSE)


#simulation of future d13c, d15n, and niche space values

group_stats <- chimp_data %>%
  group_by(Group) %>%
  summarize(
    mean_d13C = mean(d13C, na.rm = TRUE),
    sd_d13C = sd(d13C, na.rm = TRUE),
    mean_d15N = mean(d15N, na.rm = TRUE),
    sd_d15N = sd(d15N, na.rm = TRUE)
  )

chimp_data <- chimp_data %>%
  left_join(group_stats, by = "Group")

chimp_data %>%
  dplyr::select(Group, d13C, d15N, mean_d13C, sd_d13C, mean_d15N, sd_d15N)


d13c_SD_PS <- lm(sd_d13C ~ Seasonality_Precipitation, data = chimp_data)
summary(d13c_SD_PS)
d13c_mean_PS <- lm(mean_d13C ~ Seasonality_Precipitation, data = chimp_data)
summary(d13c_mean_PS)


d15n_SD_PS <- lm(sd_d15N ~ Seasonality_Precipitation, data = chimp_data)
summary(d15n_SD_PS)
d15n_mean_PS <- lm(mean_d15N ~ Seasonality_Precipitation, data = chimp_data)
summary(d15n_mean_PS)


group_stats <- chimp_data %>%
  group_by(Group) %>%
  summarize(
    orig_mean13 = mean(d13C, na.rm = TRUE),
    orig_sd13   = sd(d13C, na.rm = TRUE),
    orig_mean15 = mean(d15N, na.rm = TRUE),
    orig_sd15   = sd(d15N, na.rm = TRUE),
    n = n(),
    Seasonality_Precipitation = first(Seasonality_Precipitation),
    Seasonality_Precipitation_future = first(SSP245AVG_2041_precip)
  )

# Slopes from the seasonality regressions fit above
slope_mean_d13C <- coef(d13c_mean_PS)[["Seasonality_Precipitation"]]
slope_mean_d15N <- coef(d15n_mean_PS)[["Seasonality_Precipitation"]]
slope_sd_d13C   <- coef(d13c_SD_PS)[["Seasonality_Precipitation"]]
slope_sd_d15N   <- coef(d15n_SD_PS)[["Seasonality_Precipitation"]]

chimp_summary <- group_stats %>%
  mutate(
    delta_seas = Seasonality_Precipitation_future - Seasonality_Precipitation,
    pred_mean_d13C = orig_mean13 + slope_mean_d13C * delta_seas,
    pred_mean_d15N = orig_mean15 + slope_mean_d15N * delta_seas,
    pred_sd_d13C   = pmax(0.05, orig_sd13 + slope_sd_d13C * delta_seas),
    pred_sd_d15N   = pmax(0.05, orig_sd15 + slope_sd_d15N * delta_seas)
  )

set.seed(123)
simulated_data <- chimp_summary %>%
  rowwise() %>%
  mutate(
    sim_d13C = list(rnorm(n, mean = pred_mean_d13C, sd = pred_sd_d13C)),
    sim_d15N = list(rnorm(n, mean = pred_mean_d15N, sd = pred_sd_d15N))
  ) %>%
  unnest(cols = c(sim_d13C, sim_d15N))

write.csv(simulated_data, file.path(out_dir, "simulated_chimp_isotopes_2041_corrected.csv"), row.names = FALSE)

```

# Behavioral diversity

```{r behavior-figures}

p_label <- function(p) if (p < 0.001) "p < 0.001" else paste0("p = ", signif(p, 3))

# ---- Taï: one spelling everywhere ----
tai <- "Ta\u00EF"
fix_tai <- function(x) { x <- trimws(as.character(x)); ifelse(x == "Tai", tai, x) }

# ---- Master site order (same as other figures); subsets keep relative order ----
site_order <- c("Fongoli", "Solo", "Comoe", "Tenkere", "Bhukalai", "Issa",
                "Nguye", "Kasakati", "Kalande", "Kasekela", "Mitumba",
                "Ishasha", "Ngogo", "Ganta", tai, "Loango", "Kalinzu")
order_sites <- function(x) factor(x, levels = intersect(site_order, unique(as.character(x))))

drop_tai <- FALSE   # TRUE = run all models and plots without Taï

# ---- Data ----
behavioral_data <- read.csv("behavioral_diversity.csv") %>%
  mutate(Group = fix_tai(Group),
         Group = ifelse(Group == "Gombe", "Mitumba", Group)) %>%
  filter(!(drop_tai & Group == tai))

chimp_behavior <- chimp_data %>%
  mutate(Group = fix_tai(Group)) %>%
  dplyr::select(Group, d13C, d15N) %>%
  inner_join(
    behavioral_data %>% dplyr::select(Group, behavioral_diversity, foraging_behavioral_diversity),
    by = "Group"
  )

# Every group in the models must have a color and shape, or it would be fit but not drawn
missing <- setdiff(c(behavioral_data$Group, chimp_behavior$Group), names(group_shapes))
if (length(missing) > 0) stop("No color/shape for: ", paste(missing, collapse = ", "))

behavioral_data$Group <- order_sites(behavioral_data$Group)
chimp_behavior$Group  <- order_sites(chimp_behavior$Group)
print(table(chimp_behavior$Group))

# ---- Shared axis limits (rows share y, columns share x) ----
x_b <- range(behavioral_data$behavioral_diversity, na.rm = TRUE)
x_f <- range(behavioral_data$foraging_behavioral_diversity, na.rm = TRUE)
pad_top <- function(v) { r <- range(v, na.rm = TRUE); c(r[1], r[2] + 0.3 * diff(r)) }
y_niche <- c(0, 1.7)
y_n     <- c(1.5, 11)
y_c     <- pad_top(chimp_behavior$d13C)

theme_fig <- theme_bw(base_size = 16)

stat_label <- function(line1, line2) {
  lab <- function(txt, y_off) {
    annotation_custom(
      grid::textGrob(txt,
                     x = grid::unit(6, "pt"),
                     y = grid::unit(1, "npc") - grid::unit(y_off, "pt"),
                     hjust = 0, vjust = 1,
                     gp = grid::gpar(fontsize = 14))
    )
  }
  list(lab(line1, 6), lab(line2, 26))
}

# ---- Niche space: linear models (one value per group) ----
lm1 <- lm(Niche_space ~ behavioral_diversity, data = behavioral_data)
r2_1 <- round(summary(lm1)$adj.r.squared, 3)
pval_1 <- summary(lm1)$coefficients["behavioral_diversity", "Pr(>|t|)"]

lm2 <- lm(Niche_space ~ foraging_behavioral_diversity, data = behavioral_data)
r2_2 <- round(summary(lm2)$adj.r.squared, 3)
pval_2 <- summary(lm2)$coefficients["foraging_behavioral_diversity", "Pr(>|t|)"]

niche_plot <- function(xvar, xlab, r2, p, xlim) {
  ggplot(behavioral_data, aes(x = .data[[xvar]], y = Niche_space,
                              color = Group, shape = Group)) +
    geom_point(size = 3, stroke = 1.1, alpha = 0.7) +
    geom_smooth(aes(group = 1), method = "lm", color = "black", linewidth = 0.8,
                linetype = sig_linetype(p)) +
    stat_label(bquote("Adj" ~ R^2 == .(r2)), p_label(p)) +
    scale_color_manual(values = group_colors) +
    scale_shape_manual(values = group_shapes) +
    coord_cartesian(xlim = xlim, ylim = y_niche) +
    labs(x = xlab, y = "Isotopic Niche Space") +
    theme_fig
}

plot1 <- niche_plot("behavioral_diversity", "Behavioral Diversity", r2_1, pval_1, x_b)
plot2 <- niche_plot("foraging_behavioral_diversity", "Foraging Behavioral Diversity", r2_2, pval_2, x_f)

# ---- d13C / d15N: mixed models (random intercept for Group) ----
lmer_fixef_ci <- function(model, pred_name, seq_vals) {
  newdata <- setNames(data.frame(seq_vals), pred_name)
  X <- model.matrix(reformulate(pred_name), data = newdata)
  fit <- as.numeric(X %*% fixef(model))
  se  <- sqrt(diag(X %*% vcov(model) %*% t(X)))
  data.frame(x = seq_vals, fit = fit, ymin = fit - 2 * se, ymax = fit + 2 * se)
}

mixed_plot <- function(resp, pred, xlab, ylab, xlim, ylim) {
  model <- lmer(reformulate(c(pred, "(1 | Group)"), response = resp),
                data = chimp_behavior, REML = FALSE)
  z  <- tidy(model, effects = "fixed") %>% filter(term == pred) %>% pull(statistic)
  p  <- 2 * pnorm(-abs(z))          # Wald z-test
  r2 <- round(r2(model)$R2_marginal, 3)

  seq_vals <- seq(min(chimp_behavior[[pred]], na.rm = TRUE),
                  max(chimp_behavior[[pred]], na.rm = TRUE), length.out = 100)
  fit_df <- lmer_fixef_ci(model, pred, seq_vals)

  plt <- ggplot(chimp_behavior, aes(x = .data[[pred]], y = .data[[resp]],
                                    color = Group, shape = Group)) +
    geom_point(size = 3, stroke = 1.1, alpha = 0.7) +
    geom_ribbon(data = fit_df, aes(x = x, ymin = ymin, ymax = ymax),
                inherit.aes = FALSE, fill = "black", alpha = 0.2) +
    geom_line(data = fit_df, aes(x = x, y = fit), inherit.aes = FALSE,
              color = "black", linewidth = 0.8, linetype = sig_linetype(p)) +
    stat_label(bquote(R[m]^2 == .(r2)), p_label(p)) +
    scale_color_manual(values = group_colors) +
    scale_shape_manual(values = group_shapes) +
    coord_cartesian(xlim = xlim, ylim = ylim) +
    labs(x = xlab, y = ylab) +
    theme_fig

  list(model = model, p = p, r2 = r2, plot = plt)
}

ylab_c <- expression(paste(delta^{13}, "C (\u2030)"))
ylab_n <- expression(paste(delta^{15}, "N (\u2030)"))

res_c_behav  <- mixed_plot("d13C", "behavioral_diversity",          "Behavioral Diversity",          ylab_c, x_b, y_c)
res_c_forage <- mixed_plot("d13C", "foraging_behavioral_diversity", "Foraging Behavioral Diversity", ylab_c, x_f, y_c)
res_n_behav  <- mixed_plot("d15N", "behavioral_diversity",          "Behavioral Diversity",          ylab_n, x_b, y_n)
res_n_forage <- mixed_plot("d15N", "foraging_behavioral_diversity", "Foraging Behavioral Diversity", ylab_n, x_f, y_n)

m_d13c_behav  <- res_c_behav$model;  d13c_behav  <- res_c_behav$plot
m_d13c_forage <- res_c_forage$model; d13c_forage <- res_c_forage$plot
m_d15n_behav  <- res_n_behav$model;  d15n_behav  <- res_n_behav$plot
m_d15n_forage <- res_n_forage$model; d15n_forage <- res_n_forage$plot

# ---- Combined figure: shared axes, square panels, ticks kept on every panel ----
x_breaks <- scale_x_continuous(breaks = seq(0.2, 0.6, by = 0.2))
no_x <- theme(axis.text.x = element_blank(), axis.title.x = element_blank())
no_y <- theme(axis.text.y = element_blank(), axis.title.y = element_blank())

behavior_isotope_fig <- wrap_plots(
    plot1       + x_breaks + no_x,
    plot2       + x_breaks + no_x + no_y,
    d13c_behav  + x_breaks + no_x,
    d13c_forage + x_breaks + no_x + no_y,
    d15n_behav  + x_breaks,
    d15n_forage + x_breaks + no_y,
    ncol = 2
  ) +
  plot_layout(guides = "collect") +
  plot_annotation(tag_levels = "A") &
  theme(legend.position = "right",
        aspect.ratio = 1,
        plot.tag.location = "panel",
        plot.tag.position = c(0, 1),
        plot.tag = element_text(size = 18, face = "plain", hjust = 0, vjust = -0.3),
        plot.margin = margin(22, 6, 4, 4))

behavior_isotope_fig

ggsave(file.path(fig_dir, "Behavior_Isotope_NicheSpace_fig.png"), plot = behavior_isotope_fig,
       width = 8.5, height = 11, dpi = 400, bg = "white")

ggsave(file.path(fig_dir, "fig5_behav.tiff"), plot = behavior_isotope_fig,
       width = 9, height = 9, dpi = 600, bg = "white")

ggsave(file.path(fig_dir, "fig5_behav.pdf"), plot = behavior_isotope_fig,
       width = 9, height = 9, device = cairo_pdf, bg = "white")
```

```{r tree-cover-models}
chimp_data_noTai <- chimp_data %>%

d13c_lm <- lm(d13C ~ treeCoverMax, data = chimp_data_noTai)

d13c_pval_label <- if (d13c_pval < 0.001) {
  "p < 0.001"
```

# Vegetation metrics: maximum tree cover vs. percent evergreen

```{r evergreen-vs-treecover}

ordered_levels <- chimp_data %>%
  arrange(treeCoverMax) %>%
  pull(Group) %>%
  unique()  # make sure levels are unique

# Order sites by maximum tree cover (local copy, so other figures keep the standard site order)
chimp_long <- chimp_data %>%
  mutate(Group = factor(Group, levels = ordered_levels)) %>%
  pivot_longer(cols = c(treeCoverMax, percEvergreen),
               names_to = "Variable", values_to = "Percent")

# Dumbbell plot
ggplot(chimp_long, aes(x = Percent, y = Group, color = Variable)) +
  geom_line(aes(group = Group), color = "gray60") +
  geom_point(size = 3) +
  scale_color_manual(values = c("treeCoverMax" = "darkgreen", "percEvergreen" = "goldenrod"),
                     labels = c("Maximum Percent\nTree Cover", "Percent Evergreen"),
                     guide = guide_legend(title = NULL)) +
  labs(
    x = "Vegetation Metrics",
    y = "Group",
    title = ""
  ) +
  theme_minimal(base_size = 13)
```

```{r tree-cover-figures}
mode_model <- lm(d13C ~ treeCoverMode, data = chimp_data)
mode_r2 <- round(summary(mode_model)$adj.r.squared, 3)
mode_p <- summary(mode_model)$coefficients["treeCoverMode", "Pr(>|t|)"]
mode_p_label <- if (mode_p < 0.001) "p < 0.001" else paste0("p = ", signif(mode_p, 3))

d13C_TCMode <- ggplot(chimp_data, aes(x = treeCoverMode, y = d13C)) +
  geom_point(aes(color = Group, shape = Group),
             size = 3, alpha = 0.7, stroke = 1, position = position_jitter(width = 0.2)) +
  geom_smooth(method = "lm", se = TRUE, color = "black", linewidth = 0.8,
              linetype = sig_linetype(mode_p)) +
  annotate("text",
           x = min(chimp_data$treeCoverMode, na.rm = TRUE),
           y = min(chimp_data$d13C, na.rm = TRUE),
           hjust = 0, vjust = 0, size = 4,
           label = paste0("Adj R² = ", mode_r2, "\n", mode_p_label)) +
  scale_color_manual(values = group_colors) +
  scale_shape_manual(values = group_shapes) +
  labs(x = "Modal Tree Canopy Cover (%)", y = NULL) +
  theme_bw() +
  theme(text = element_text(size = 13), axis.text = element_text(size = 12),
        axis.text.y = element_blank(), axis.ticks.y = element_blank())
d13C_TCMode

# Linear model: Max
max_model <- lm(d13C ~ treeCoverMax, data = chimp_data)
max_r2 <- round(summary(max_model)$adj.r.squared, 3)
max_p <- summary(max_model)$coefficients["treeCoverMax", "Pr(>|t|)"]
max_p_label <- if (max_p < 0.001) "p < 0.001" else paste0("p = ", signif(max_p, 3))

d13C_TCMax <- ggplot(chimp_data, aes(x = treeCoverMax, y = d13C)) +
  geom_point(aes(color = Group, shape = Group),
             size = 3, alpha = 0.7, stroke = 1, position = position_jitter(width = 0.2)) +
  geom_smooth(method = "lm", se = TRUE, color = "black", linewidth = 0.8,
              linetype = sig_linetype(max_p)) +
  annotate("text",
           x = min(chimp_data$treeCoverMax, na.rm = TRUE),
           y = min(chimp_data$d13C, na.rm = TRUE),
           hjust = 0, vjust = 0, size = 4,
           label = paste0("Adj R² = ", max_r2, "\n", max_p_label)) +
  scale_color_manual(values = group_colors) +
  scale_shape_manual(values = group_shapes) +
  labs(x = "Maximum Tree Canopy Cover (%)", y = expression(delta^13*C~("\u2030"))) +
  theme_bw() +
  theme(text = element_text(size = 13), axis.text = element_text(size = 12))

# Linear model: Min
min_model <- lm(d13C ~ treeCoverMin, data = chimp_data)
min_r2 <- round(summary(min_model)$adj.r.squared, 3)
min_p <- summary(min_model)$coefficients["treeCoverMin", "Pr(>|t|)"]
min_p_label <- if (min_p < 0.001) "p < 0.001" else paste0("p = ", signif(min_p, 3))

d13C_TCMin <- ggplot(chimp_data, aes(x = treeCoverMin, y = d13C)) +
  geom_point(aes(color = Group, shape = Group),
             size = 3, alpha = 0.7, stroke = 1, position = position_jitter(width = 0.2)) +
  geom_smooth(method = "lm", se = TRUE, color = "black", linewidth = 0.8,
              linetype = sig_linetype(min_p)) +
  annotate("text",
           x = max(chimp_data$treeCoverMin, na.rm = TRUE),
           y = max(chimp_data$d13C, na.rm = TRUE),
           hjust = 1, vjust = 1, size = 4,
           label = paste0("Adj R² = ", min_r2, "\n", min_p_label)) +
  scale_color_manual(values = group_colors) +
  scale_shape_manual(values = group_shapes) +
  labs(x = "Minimum Tree Canopy Cover (%)", y = NULL) +
  theme_bw() +
  theme(text = element_text(size = 13), axis.text = element_text(size = 12),
        axis.text.y = element_blank(), axis.ticks.y = element_blank())

# Combine plots (2x2)
combined_TC_d13C <- (d13C_TCMean + theme(legend.position = "none")) +
                    (d13C_TCMode + theme(legend.position = "none")) +
                    (d13C_TCMax + theme(legend.position = "none")) +
                    (d13C_TCMin + theme(legend.position = "none")) +
                    plot_layout(ncol = 2, guides = "collect") &
                    theme(legend.position = "right")

# View plot
combined_TC_d13C

# Save
ggsave(file.path(fig_dir, "Figure1_TreeCanopy_d13C_fixed.png"), combined_TC_d13C,
       width = 10, height = 8, dpi = 300)


#percent evergreen

# Linear model for d13C ~ percEvergreen
d13c_PE_lm <- lm(d13C ~ percEvergreen, data = chimp_data)
summary(d13c_PE_lm)

# Extract R² and p-value
cPE_r2 <- round(summary(d13c_PE_lm)$adj.r.squared, 3)
cPE_pval <- summary(d13c_PE_lm)$coefficients["percEvergreen", "Pr(>|t|)"]
cPE_pval_label <- if (cPE_pval < 0.001) {
  "p < 0.001"
} else {
  paste0("p = ", signif(cPE_pval, 3))
}

# Plot δ13C vs Percent Evergreen
d13c_PE <- ggplot(data = chimp_data, mapping = aes(x = percEvergreen, y = d13C)) +
  geom_point(
    aes(color = Group, shape = Group),
    size = 3, stroke = 1, alpha = 0.7,
    position = position_jitter(width = 0.2)
  ) +
  geom_smooth(method = "lm", se = TRUE, color = "black", linewidth = 0.8,
              linetype = sig_linetype(cPE_pval)) +
  annotate("text",
           x = min(chimp_data$percEvergreen, na.rm = TRUE),
           y = min(chimp_data$d13C, na.rm = TRUE),
           hjust = 0, vjust = 0, size = 4,
           label = paste0("Adj R² = ", cPE_r2, "\n", cPE_pval_label)) +
  coord_cartesian(ylim = c(min(chimp_data$d13C, na.rm = TRUE), NA)) +
  theme_bw() +
  theme(
    axis.line = element_line(size = 0.5, color = "black"),
    panel.background = element_blank(),
    text = element_text(size = 13),
    axis.text.x = element_text(color = "black", size = 13),
    axis.text.y = element_text(color = "black", size = 13)
  ) +
  scale_fill_manual(values = group_colors) +
  scale_color_manual(values = group_colors) +
  scale_shape_manual(values = group_shapes) +
  ylab(expression(paste(delta^{13}, "C (\u2030)"))) +
  xlab("Percent Evergreen Forest")

chimp_data_noTai <- chimp_data %>%
  filter(Group != tai)

d13c_gam <- gam(d13C ~ s(treeCoverMax, k = 3), data = chimp_data_noTai)

d13c_gam_summary <- summary(d13c_gam)
d13c_gam_r2 <- round(d13c_gam_summary$r.sq, 3)
d13c_edf <- round(d13c_gam_summary$s.table[1, "edf"], 2)
d13c_gam_pval <- d13c_gam_summary$s.table[1, "p-value"]
d13c_gam_pval_label <- if (d13c_gam_pval < 0.001) {
  "p < 0.001"
} else {
  paste0("p = ", signif(d13c_gam_pval, 3))
}

d13c_seq <- seq(
  from = min(chimp_data_noTai$treeCoverMax, na.rm = TRUE),
  to   = max(chimp_data_noTai$treeCoverMax, na.rm = TRUE),
  length.out = 200
)

d13c_pred_gam <- predict(d13c_gam,
                         newdata = data.frame(treeCoverMax = d13c_seq),
                         se.fit = TRUE)

d13c_PTCm_gam <- ggplot(chimp_data_noTai, aes(x = treeCoverMax, y = d13C,
                                              color = Group, shape = Group)) +
  geom_point(size = 3) +
  geom_line(data = data.frame(treeCoverMax = d13c_seq, d13C = d13c_pred_gam$fit),
            aes(x = treeCoverMax, y = d13C), inherit.aes = FALSE,
            color = "black", linewidth = 0.8) +
  geom_ribbon(data = data.frame(treeCoverMax = d13c_seq,
                                ymin = d13c_pred_gam$fit - 2 * d13c_pred_gam$se.fit,
                                ymax = d13c_pred_gam$fit + 2 * d13c_pred_gam$se.fit),
              aes(x = treeCoverMax, ymin = ymin, ymax = ymax),
              inherit.aes = FALSE, fill = "black", alpha = 0.2) +
  annotate("text",
           x = min(d13c_seq),
           y = max(chimp_data_noTai$d13C, na.rm = TRUE),
           hjust = 0, vjust = 1, size = 3.5,
           label = paste0("Adj R² = ", d13c_gam_r2,
                          "\nEDF = ", d13c_edf,
                          "\n", d13c_gam_pval_label)) +
  scale_color_manual(values = group_colors) +
  scale_shape_manual(values = group_shapes) +
  labs(title = "", x = "Maximum Tree Canopy Cover (%)",
       y = expression(paste(delta^{13}, "C (\u2030)"))) +
  theme_bw() +
  theme(axis.title = element_text(size = 11),
        axis.text = element_text(size = 10))

d13c_PTCm_gam

ggsave(file.path(fig_dir, "Figure3_d13C_treeCoverMax_noTai.png"),
       plot = d13c_PTCm_gam,
       width = 5.5, height = 4.5, dpi = 400)
```
